# Separate evidence gaps from style preferences

Review comments that distinguish evidence gaps from style preferences get acted on;
mixed comments get argued with. When a shortlist entry fails review, name the missing
evidence in one sentence and keep any stylistic advice in a clearly separate sentence,
so the shortlist owner knows which fixes require a new discovery pass and which are a
five-minute edit. A review that blends the two costs a full round trip.
